defs.def: that is legally or officially acceptable （法律上）有效的；（正式）认可的

ex.s: All customers travelling on TransLink services must be in possession of a valid ticket before boarding.
ex.t: 所有乘坐TransLink服务的顾客在登机前必须持有有效的车票。

ex.s: Your card is valid during the whole time of your studies.
ex.t: 你的卡在你整个学习期间有效。

ex.s: If you want to determine whether a piece of news is valid, it is also necessary search can determine whether the reporter or publisher can be trusted.
ex.t: 如果你想判断一条新闻是否可靠，同样有必要（……）搜索可以确定记者或出版方是否值得信任。

defs.def: based on what is logical or true 符合逻辑的；合理的；有根据的；确凿的
that is accepted by the system 有效的；系统认可的

ex.s: When St．Augustine admitted his inability to define time， he highlighted one of time 's most noticeable qualities：Time becomes meaningful only in a defined context．Any timekeeping system is valid，and each is as praiseworthy as its purpose．
ex.t: 当圣奥古斯丁承认自己无法定义时间时，他指出了时间最显著的特性之一：时间只有在特定的语境中才有意义。任何计时系统都是有效的，而每一种都因其用途而值得称赞。
